prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. In paragraph p6, replace the single word "WYSIWYG" with "RTF" (rename the noun so the change is visible in both the deletion and the insertion). Write the result to {output}. Use --author {author} for the new edit. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} contains "open-source RTF" in p6 and no edit failed; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Exactly one substitution by PilotBot; no other paragraph changed; surrounding punctuation preserved.
